crossRefs.note: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.
Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!
If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,
for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to…
to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,
that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.
For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

translations.web: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.
translations.bsb: Take the garment of the one who posts security for a stranger; get collateral if it is for a foreigner.
translations.kjv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger: and take a pledge of him for a strange woman.
translations.asv: Take his garment that is surety for a stranger; And hold him in pledge that is surety for foreigners.
